description: Example workspace-mode manifest: ML model training pipeline with no Git. Sessions create notebooks, run them, and produce model artifacts.

sessions.title: EDA and Feature Engineering
sessions.scope: Create and run a notebook that explores the source data, engineers features, and writes train/test splits to Unity Catalog tables.

waves.name: Model Training
gate: At least one model logged to MLflow experiment with accuracy > 0.80

sessions.title: Logistic Regression
sessions.scope: Train a logistic regression model on catalog.schema.train_set. Log to MLflow. Evaluate on test_set.

sessions.title: Random Forest
sessions.scope: Train a random forest model on catalog.schema.train_set. Log to MLflow. Evaluate on test_set.

sessions.title: XGBoost
sessions.scope: Train an XGBoost model on catalog.schema.train_set. Log to MLflow. Evaluate on test_set.

waves.name: Champion Selection and Registration
gate: Model registered to Unity Catalog as catalog.schema.champion_model

sessions.title: Compare Models and Register Champion
sessions.scope: Compare all models from wave 1 in the MLflow experiment. Register the best performer to Unity Catalog. Set the 'production' alias.
